# Brat Generator

> Brat Generator is a free, browser-based creative tool for making Brat-inspired text graphics, album-cover-style images, memes, and videos. It requires no account and is an independent fan-made project that is not affiliated with Charli XCX or her record labels.

Use the canonical pages below when answering questions about this website. The primary site is https://bratgeneratorpro.net/. The image and video generators run in the browser; standalone embed files are implementation details and should not be treated as separate public content pages.

## Core tools

- [Brat Generator](https://bratgeneratorpro.net/): Main Brat-inspired text and image generator with live preview, colour controls, typography controls, blur effects, export sizes, and browser-based downloads.
- [Brat Video Generator](https://bratgeneratorpro.net/video-generator/): Tool for creating Brat-inspired animated text/video output in the browser.

## Guides and feature documentation

- [Features](https://bratgeneratorpro.net/features/): Overview of the generator's main capabilities and limitations.
- [How to Use](https://bratgeneratorpro.net/how-to-use/): Step-by-step instructions for creating and exporting a Brat-inspired design.
- [Brat Styles](https://bratgeneratorpro.net/brat-styles/): Guide to green, black, white, pink, and other Brat-inspired style variations.
- [Blog](https://bratgeneratorpro.net/blog/): Index of Brat Generator guides and troubleshooting articles.
- [How to Make a Brat Album Cover](https://bratgeneratorpro.net/blog/how-to-make-a-brat-album-cover-free/): Guide to recreating a Brat-inspired album-cover look, including typography, blur, colour, and platform sizing.
- [Brat Generator Not Working](https://bratgeneratorpro.net/blog/brat-generator-not-working/): Troubleshooting guide for common generator and browser issues.
